description: React component file 'AvailabilityManager.tsx' that manages the user interface for displaying, adding, updating, and deleting availability windows for doctors and ICU rooms. It includes data fetching, form handling, inline editing, and integrates with backend API endpoints.

methods.name: api
methods.description: Helper function to fetch data from API endpoints with error handling.

methods.name: fetchDoctors
methods.description: Fetch list of doctors from backend API.

methods.name: fetchICUs
methods.description: Fetch list of ICU rooms from backend API.

methods.name: fetchAvailabilities
methods.description: Fetch list of availability entries from backend API.

methods.name: createAvailabilityApi
methods.description: Send POST request to create a new availability.

methods.name: updateAvailabilityApi
methods.description: Send PUT request to update existing availability by ID.

methods.name: deleteAvailabilityApi
methods.description: Send DELETE request to remove an availability by ID.
